name: browser-use
headline: 2026 coach: Plan future goals
short_description: 2026-coach is an executive coaching skill that helps plan 2026 using research-backed process goals. It benefits executives and managers by guiding them through structured goal-setting. The skill integrates with Claude Code and Claude.ai for workflow. It is applied in strategic planning and performance management.
author: BayramAnnakov

sections.overview:
2026-coach helps executives and managers structure their annual planning using process goals—daily controllable behaviors proven 15x more effective than outcome goals by Williamson et al. (2022). The skill guides you through discovery, goal hierarchy creation, and weekly/daily checklist generation, producing a complete strategic plan with quarterly milestones and actionable daily behaviors. Instead of abstract targets like "make $100K," you define controllable daily actions like "send 20 messages." The skill works with Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Claude.ai, creating tracking files (2026_PLAN.md, COACHING_CONTEXT.md, WEEK_XX.md) for ongoing coaching and accountability.
Annual strategic planning for executives and managers
Converting outcome goals to daily process goals and behaviors
Creating quarterly milestone roadmaps with weekly checklists
Building self-efficacy through small, controllable daily wins
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/BayramAnnakov/2026-coach`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a 2026-coach. Help me set process goals for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Use the following data: [DATA]. Guide me through structured goal-setting for 2026, focusing on the journey rather than just the outcome.
```
Copy

```
# 2026 Process Goals for Tech Innovators Inc.
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
